title: HeatAQ Nexus synthetic reproducibility demonstration
description: A deterministic CPU-first forecasting experiment that exercises chronological train/calibration/test evaluation, transparent baselines, tree models, conformal uncertainty, event metrics and paper-ready outputs.

report.title: HeatAQ Nexus: Reproducible Synthetic Forecasting Demonstration
report.subtitle: Paper-ready reproducible environmental forecasting results
report.author: Faramarz Kowsari
report.abstract: This report records a reproducible HeatAQ Nexus forecasting experiment with chronological evaluation, explicit baselines, uncertainty metrics, checksums and exact reproduction commands.

notes: No paid AI API is used.
limitations: Results apply only to the evaluated data identity and split protocol.
Synthetic demonstration data are a software-validation fixture, not evidence about a real city.
The system is not an official warning service or medical decision tool.
